details:
- They look too busy with too much text in the same place, and it is a lot more difficult to identify someone's name - the most important part of a NAMEplate.

- The text position is clearly off-center to allow space for decorations on the right side, but it just ends up looking off, with or without decorations.

- All of the text has the same weight. It all meshes together at a glance, making it look like I'm reading a wall of text.

- Mutual amount should not be on the nameplate at all.

- Group banners are centered vertically differently, which is a spit in the face to all the work put into existing banners.

- Friend indicator just looks so out of place, much worse than the previous yellow text.

- Nameplates are excessively large now, even when set to the smallest size.

- Player icon is too small and given less importance than before.

Nameplate and profile icon decorations add too much visual clutter. It just feels like it's copying Discord for the sake of copying it, a feature that many within Discord already think is too much. It feels greedy and a cheap way to make more money.

If there were an option to turn those off, I would do it immediately.

I was going to design a mockup with some changes, but I don't work for VRChat, I'm not getting paid. I'm sure you can do better than this if you try a little harder next time.
title: [1878] New nameplates simply look bad
